snippet.title: Civilization 2 gameplay (PC Game, 1996)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Civilization 2 (aka civ 2), PC game produced by Microprose in 1996 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/civilization-2/174/
Playing as Roman civilization. First centuries passed discovery the land, creating cities and growing new technologies. Then, a war with Chinese civilization started. Game with original sound, no talk through. .
Played through emulated Windows (Win 98/Win XP) virtual machine.
Recorded with original sound.
